Matched experience e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01
e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when deferred editor persistence must preserve synchronous departure persistence, inline save-listener navigation, and entry-bound submissions with visit-bound notices. TASK states: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save. Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." README.md states: "When close/open returns, the departed document's last accepted edit is readable\nfrom the store. A close/open request retires its previous save badge immediately."

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R02 [Event relation]
Update the accepting editor's in-memory text synchronously, then enqueue persistence using the existing trailing-task utility with a 120 ms quiet interval. Bind delayed work to the accepting document rather than consulting the later selection. Preserve editing without a selection as a no-op and allow empty text. src/editor.js contains "if (!current) return;" and "current.text = text;". TASK requires: "Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." The internal ownership structure may vary if these observable requirements hold.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R03 [Event relation]
Retire a consumed batch before invoking persistence so nested flushing cannot consume it twice and edits accepted by an inline listener establish independent pending work. Preserve src/trailing-task.js ordering: "    handle = null;\n    const args = pending;\n    pending = null;\n    if (args !== null) work(...args);" Do not add completion cleanup that erases a callback-enqueued batch.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R04 [Event relation]
On departure, capture the old editor resources, revoke current ownership, detach its badge, and complete old-view clearing before flushing its pending persistence, or protect any remaining effects against newer navigation. Flush before reading a replacement document. Recheck navigation request authority after callback-capable persistence before installing a destination. README.md states: "Reopening a document restores its saved text in a new editor visit." It also states: "Navigation precedence is\nordered by request start: a request that starts later wins even when an earlier\nrequest returns afterward." src/save-status.js requires that the departing badge "must produce no further output, including during that\n// navigation call." Cleanup must use captured departing resources so it cannot detach or erase a successor's resources or edits.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R05 [Event relation]
At submission entry, capture the originating visit and its document/text snapshot before persistence can invoke integrations. Persist the accepted text before archive capture, then create and return exactly one receipt even if persistence navigates or accepts further edits. README.md states: "`submit()` accepts the document and latest text selected at its call entry." It further requires: "Accepted text\nmust be persisted before the archive captures the receipt. Later edits or\nnavigation cannot change that receipt's document, text, or obligation to exist." Preserve the no-selection null result without creating a receipt.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R06 [Preservation]
Authorize submission notice output using the exact originating visit after callback-capable persistence; receipt validity and notice permission have separate lifetimes. README.md states: "Its visible submission notice belongs only\nto the editor visit that accepted the action: it may appear only if that same\nvisit is still active when the notice is emitted." It also states: "Reopening the same document\ncreates a different visit. Any navigation clears the previous submission notice." An uninterrupted submit must display its receipt and leave editing usable. Do not use document-ID equality to represent visit identity or infer authority from receipt contents.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R07 [Preservation]
Preserve synchronous workspace interfaces, store event/revision semantics, live status filtering, subscription cleanup, renderer argument shapes, and immutable archive snapshots with copied listings. src/save-status.js filters with "if (event.id === id) renderStatus(event);" src/receipt-archive.js contains "const receipt = Object.freeze({ id, text });" and "list() { return receipts.map(receipt => ({ ...receipt })); }," Preserve disposal ordering from src/workspace.js: "return { ...navigation, dispose() { stop(); navigation.close(); } };" Keep preview behavior separate: TASK states "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/search-preview.js uses "const task = createTrailingTask(query => publish({ query }), 40, timers);" and "hide() { task.cancel(); },".

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R08 [Exclusion]
Do not generalize departure flushing to contracts that explicitly discard pending work, require persistent buffer banks merely because documents persist, or introduce callbacks from output sinks. README.md states: "Render functions and the receipt archive are output\nsinks and never call back into the workspace." A final installation guard alone does not protect stale clearing effects after store callbacks; complete those effects first or validate their authority.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R09 [Verification]
Check timer resetting, no write before 120 ms of quiet, one latest-text write per burst, later successful bursts, empty text, and no-selection editing. With pending edits, exercise switch, same-document reopen, close, and dispose; verify before-return persistence, fresh reads, and immediate badge retirement. Trigger nested open or close from timer-, departure-, and submission-driven store notifications, and edit the resulting visit; verify later navigation wins, successor output survives, and callback-enqueued work saves independently without duplicate consumption. During submit, independently verify the entry snapshot, persistence before capture, exactly one returned receipt, notice suppression after navigation or same-document reopening, uninterrupted notice output, and subsequent editing. Check no-selection submission and unchanged preview delay, hide cancellation, and later-query usability. These checks derive from TASK and public source obligations, not from the acceptance verdict.


Matched experience 15336311f26a6afa71502d60f5b82b62d669691dd734cde98439e18d41d5661e
15336311f26a6afa71502d60f5b82b62d669691dd734cde98439e18d41d5661e:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when introducing trailing persistence into a synchronous editor whose save listeners can navigate. TASK requires "after a 120 ms quiet interval write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts must continue to save." README.md requires "Returning to a document creates a fresh editor visit and restores persisted text." These requirements make persistence boundaries and visit identity part of preserving supported behavior.

15336311f26a6afa71502d60f5b82b62d669691dd734cde98439e18d41d5661e:R02 [Event relation]
Keep the visit's immutable in-memory text current immediately, then push it into that visit's reusable trailing task. Preserve pending edits at departure and before submission capture rather than canceling them. Preserve the utility's clearing of pending state before invoking work: src/workflow.rb contains "    @handle = @pending = nil\n    @work.call(value) unless value.nil?" This allows edits admitted by a save callback to form an independent subsequent batch.

15336311f26a6afa71502d60f5b82b62d669691dd734cde98439e18d41d5661e:R03 [Event relation]
Capture the departing visit and remove its current ownership before flushing its pending save. Finish its passive clearing output before the flush, or guard remaining output after callbacks. Complete cleanup using the captured visit. After departure, an outer open must recheck its navigation request before installing its destination. Saving is callback-capable: src/workflow.rb states "    @listeners.to_a.each { |token, block| block.call(event) if @listeners.key?(token) }" Nested navigation, edits, subscriptions and rendering must remain authoritative.

15336311f26a6afa71502d60f5b82b62d669691dd734cde98439e18d41d5661e:R04 [Event relation]
For submission, capture the selected visit, its snapshot and its confirmation capability before flushing pending persistence. Flush before archive capture, then return the receipt even if navigation suppresses its notice. Recheck the originating visit immediately before notice output, including after archive listeners run. README.md states "An outlet acquires the visit active when binding is called; it cannot infer an earlier action from a receipt. Each opening creates a new identity." src/workflow.rb enforces identity with "  def active;!@owner.nil?&&@owner.equal?(@current.call);end".

15336311f26a6afa71502d60f5b82b62d669691dd734cde98439e18d41d5661e:R05 [Preservation]
Preserve synchronous public interfaces, immutable text copies, subscription delivery and fresh visits, including reopening the same document ID. Preserve the null result when no editor is selected and receipt delivery independently of notice permission. Leave preview scheduling and cancellation unchanged: TASK states "Preserve other supported behavior and the synchronous public interfaces. The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change."

15336311f26a6afa71502d60f5b82b62d669691dd734cde98439e18d41d5661e:R06 [Exclusion]
Do not let a successful receipt authorize output for a retired visit, use document ID equality as visit identity, or assume that code after a save still owns navigation. A guard on final installation alone does not protect stale clearing output. Apply the current task's explicit boundary policy; this guidance does not require flushing work that another contract explicitly discards.

15336311f26a6afa71502d60f5b82b62d669691dd734cde98439e18d41d5661e:R07 [Verification]
Check several edits within 120 ms yield one latest-text write and a later burst saves again. Check close, switch, same-document reopening and disposal preserve pending text. During timer-driven, departure-driven and submission-driven saves, have a store listener open or close the workspace and edit the resulting visit; verify the outer continuation preserves that visit and its pending batch. During submission, navigate from both store and archive listeners; verify the original snapshot and returned receipt survive while stale notices are suppressed. Also check no-selection submission, subscription delivery, and the unchanged 40 ms preview and hide behavior.


Matched experience 4d6563fed6127800ec4b4f2159aaafca3bf11afe9d7cc78b86d5fe32cba9731e
4d6563fed6127800ec4b4f2159aaafca3bf11afe9d7cc78b86d5fe32cba9731e:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when per-document pending work survives presentation retirement and saving can synchronously navigate. README.md states: "Document body, per-document buffer and navigation outline are separate responsibilities." It also states: "Workspace coordinates visits; saved integrations may synchronously navigate and outline retains a breadcrumb archive." src/workflow.rb provides reusable buffers through "def get(env,id);@entries[id] ||= Trailing.new(env,120) {|text| env.write(id,text)};end".

4d6563fed6127800ec4b4f2159aaafca3bf11afe9d7cc78b86d5fe32cba9731e:R02 [Event relation]
Capture the current view and enqueue an acceptance-time copy of its text in that view's document buffer. Preserve the no-current-view no-op and original document association. TASK states: "autosave to coalesce a burst of input: after 120 ms without another edit, save\nonly its latest text. Reuse the existing trailing-task utility where appropriate." Existing src/workflow.rb immediately copies stored text with "@records[id] = text.dup.freeze"; deferring that copy until consumption would allow caller mutation to change accepted text. Keep separate reusable buffers rather than redirecting pending text through the later current view.

4d6563fed6127800ec4b4f2159aaafca3bf11afe9d7cc78b86d5fe32cba9731e:R03 [Event relation]
Retire consumed pending state before invoking callback-capable work so nested flushing cannot duplicate it and nested edits can establish another burst. Preserve src/workflow.rb ordering: "value = @pending\n    @handle = @pending = nil\n    @work.call(value) unless value.nil?". Empty text must remain consumable.

4d6563fed6127800ec4b4f2159aaafca3bf11afe9d7cc78b86d5fe32cba9731e:R04 [Event relation]
Capture the departing view, revoke its current ownership, detach its captured subscription and finish its clearing presentation before flushing its buffer. Preserve the reusable buffer. TASK states: "Preserve the workspace's existing navigation and persistence behavior." The original src/workflow.rb edit path is "def edit(text);view=@current;@env.write(view.id,text) if view;end". Flushing pending text during departure preserves synchronous store availability across switch, same-document reopen, close and dispose while permitting active editing to coalesce. Ownership alone does not establish this scheduling requirement for other tasks.

4d6563fed6127800ec4b4f2159aaafca3bf11afe9d7cc78b86d5fe32cba9731e:R05 [Event relation]
Guard both editor installation and workspace projection publication against navigation invoked during saving. Recheck the editor request generation after retirement, and recheck the workspace epoch after editor open or close before committing or clearing the projection. src/workflow.rb already captures "@generation+=1;request=@generation" and "@epoch+=1;mine=@epoch". docs/host-api.md states: "Store reads values and synchronously notifies saved integrations." Nested navigation must retain its selection, document rendering, visit identity and projection; an outer stale clear is also an unauthorized visible effect.

4d6563fed6127800ec4b4f2159aaafca3bf11afe9d7cc78b86d5fe32cba9731e:R06 [Preservation]
Preserve current-document status filtering, captured subscription cleanup, store event identity/text/revision semantics and copied breadcrumb history. src/workflow.rb filters with "if e[:id]==id", detaches with "def detach;@env.store.stop(@token);end", and publishes trail copies with "@trail.map(&:dup)". docs/host-api.md states: "Document and projection sinks carry visit identifiers; committed outline keeps a copied breadcrumb trail." Clearing selection must retain the existing breadcrumb archive.

4d6563fed6127800ec4b4f2159aaafca3bf11afe9d7cc78b86d5fe32cba9731e:R07 [Exclusion]
Keep transient preview policy separate from durable document edits. TASK states: "Keep\nsearch preview behavior unchanged; its timing is outside this maintenance task." Preserve src/workflow.rb: "def initialize(env);@task=Trailing.new(env,40){|q| env.output('preview',{'query'=>q})};end" and "def hide;@task.cancel;end". Do not infer audit or decoding retention requirements from breadcrumb preservation.

4d6563fed6127800ec4b4f2159aaafca3bf11afe9d7cc78b86d5fe32cba9731e:R08 [Verification]
Verify latest-only saving after 120 ms of quiet, later independent bursts, empty text, mutation of caller-owned text after acceptance and editing with no current view. Exercise pending edits across switch, same-document reopen, close and dispose; check original-document persistence, buffer reuse and captured subscription removal. Trigger nested select and close from timer-driven and departure-driven saves; check final selection, document/projection visit agreement, breadcrumb copies, successor rendering and subsequent nested edits. Confirm preview retains its 40 ms delay and hide cancellation. These checks operationalize TASK's coalescing and preservation instructions; they are not claims about supplied behavioral test coverage.

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R01 [Applicability]

It also states: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously."

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R02 [Event relation]
Capture the current document buffer when accepting an edit and enqueue its text there. Retain the original document identity and persistent buffer reuse across view retirement. TASK states: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." src/coordinator.js already binds each buffer's consumer with "trailing(env.timers,120,text=>env.store.write(id,text))".

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R03 [Event relation]
Before a callback-capable save, snapshot and retire the consumed pending state so reentrant flushing cannot duplicate it and reentrant editing can create an independent subsequent burst. Reuse the existing utility's ordering in src/services.js: "const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };"

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R04 [Event relation]
Capture the departing view and revoke its current ownership before saving pending work. Complete its clearing render before callback-capable saving, or recheck authority before any remaining visible effect. Clean up the captured subscription. After retirement returns, an outer open must recheck its request identity before installing its view. Preserve nested navigation, nested edits and successor rendering.

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R05 [Preservation]
Preserve accepted text on its original document, independent pending state for different documents, buffer reuse, current-document status filtering and original rendering and payload semantics. docs/host-api.md states: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." Preserve teardown integration in src/Workspace.vue: "onBeforeUnmount(api.dispose);"

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R06 [Exclusion]
Determine departure scheduling from the task and existing behavior separately from ownership. For this editor, flushing the captured departing buffer before retirement returns preserves synchronous store availability while allowing active edits to coalesce. Do not generalize this into a deadline for every persistent owner, cancel accepted durable edits merely because a subscription retires, or destroy the store-owned buffer during view cleanup.

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R07 [Preservation]
Keep transient preview policy separate. TASK states: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." Preserve src/services.js: "const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));" and "return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};"

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R08 [Verification]
Check latest-only saving after the quiet interval, subsequent bursts and empty-string edits. With pending edits, exercise switch, same-document reopen, close, dispose and Vue unmount; check original-document persistence, buffer identity, captured subscription cleanup and successor presentation. Trigger nested open and close from both timer-driven and departure-driven saves, then check final navigation, rendered output and nested edits. Confirm preview delay and hide cancellation remain intact.
